mn76:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosambiyaṃ viharati ghositārāme.
mn76:2.1: tena kho pana samayena sandako paribbājako pilakkhaguhāyaṃ paṭivasati mahatiyā paribbājakaparisāya saddhiṃ pañcamattehi paribbājakasatehi.
mn76:3.1: atha kho āyasmā ānando sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito bhikkhū āmantesi
mn76:3.3: evamāvusoti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato ānandassa paccassosuṃ.
mn76:3.4: atha kho āyasmā ānando sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ yena devakaṭasobbho tenupasaṅkami.
mn76:4.1: tena kho pana samayena sandako paribbājako mahatiyā paribbājakaparisāya saddhiṃ nisinno hoti unnādiniyā uccāsaddamahāsaddāya anekavihitaṃ tiracchānakathaṃ kathentiyā seyyathīdaṃ
mn76:4.2: rājakathaṃ corakathaṃ mahāmattakathaṃ senākathaṃ bhayakathaṃ yuddhakathaṃ annakathaṃ pānakathaṃ sayanakathaṃ mālākathaṃ gandhakathaṃ ñātikathaṃ yānakathaṃ gāmakathaṃ nigamakathaṃ nagarakathaṃ janapadakathaṃ itthīkathaṃ sūrakathaṃ visikhākathaṃ kumbhaṭṭhānakathaṃ kumbhadāsikathaṃ pubbapetakathaṃ nānattakathaṃ lokakkhāyikaṃ samuddakkhāyikaṃ itibhavābhavakathaṃ iti vā.
mn76:4.3: addasā kho sandako paribbājako āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ
mn76:4.5: appasaddā bhonto hontu mā bhonto saddamakattha
mn76:4.6: ayaṃ samaṇassa gotamassa sāvako āgacchati samaṇo ānando
mn76:4.7: yāvatā kho pana samaṇassa gotamassa sāvakā kosambiyaṃ paṭivasanti ayantesaṃ aññataro samaṇo ānando
mn76:4.8: appasaddakāmā kho pana te āyasmanto appasaddavinītā appasaddassa vaṇṇavādino
mn76:4.9: appevanāma appasaddaṃ parisaṃ viditvā upasaṅkamitabbaṃ maññeyyāti.
mn76:4.10: atha kho te paribbājakā tuṇhī ahesuṃ.
mn76:5.1: atha kho āyasmā ānando yena sandako paribbājako tenupasaṅkami.
mn76:5.2: atha kho pana sandako paribbājako āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca
mn76:5.3: etu kho bhavaṃ ānando svāgataṃ bhoto ānandassa
mn76:5.4: cirassaṃ kho bhavaṃ ānando imaṃ pariyāyamakāsi yadidaṃ idhāgamanāya
mn76:5.6: nisīdi kho āyasmā ānando paññatte āsane.
mn76:5.7: sandakopi kho paribbājako aññataraṃ nīcaṃ āsanaṃ gahetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
mn76:5.8: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho sandakaṃ paribbājakaṃ āyasmā ānando etadavoca
mn76:5.9: kāya nuttha sandaka etarahi kathāya sannisinnā kā ca pana vo antarākathā vippakatāti.
mn76:5.10: tiṭṭhatesā bho ānanda kathā yāya mayaṃ etarahi kathāya sannisinnā
mn76:5.11: nesā bhoto ānandassa kathā dullabhā bhavissati pacchāpi savanāya
mn76:5.12: sādhu vata bhavantaṃyeva ānandaṃ paṭibhātu sake ācariyake dhammī kathāti.
mn76:5.13: tenahi sandaka suṇāhi sādhukaṃ manasikarohi bhāsissāmīti.
mn76:5.14: evaṃ bhoti kho sandako paribbājako āyasmato ānandassa paccassosi.
mn76:6.1: cattārome sandaka tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena abrahmacariyavāsā akkhātā cattāri ca anassāsikāni brahmacariyāni akkhātāni yattha viññū puriso sasakkaṃ brahmacariyaṃ na vaseyya vasanto ca nārādheyya ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalanti.
